grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or good stock, with no jars, stock pots or packet mixes.

supermarket.reason: Celery, chicken thighs, pearl barley and stock are everyday Tesco items at ordinary prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only one lidded pan and two forks, and the techniques are simple softening, simmering and shredding.

works.reason: Six thighs, 150g barley and 1.2 litres of stock make a sensible, generous soup for four, and 40 minutes is right for tender barley.

honest_times.reason: Twenty-five minutes covers slicing a head of celery, the onion and carrots, ten minutes of softening, and shredding the chicken, and the 40-minute simmer matches the cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the thyme, lemon and parsley, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming barley soup suits late September, and a whole head of celery plus its leaves makes celery central rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps read as clear, plain British home-cook instructions.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling soup of chicken, barley and vegetables that a family would happily eat again.
